records.description: Utilizing Geographical Information Systems (GIS) and mapping tools to examine and visualize epidemiological and social science data; assess public health, social, and policy issues including obesity, cardiovascular disease, and drug use; explore how this work can be applied to interventions. Required preparation must include a college-level statistics course.  (Crosslisted course offered as NEP 462/562, SOC 462/562.) Credit not granted for both NEP 462/562 and SOC 462/562.
